Search chain: SearXNG -> DuckDuckGo HTML -> Google CSE
Rejected: port legacy Python/LangGraph implementation (request-time scraping is root cause of latency/reliability problems)
Rejected: two SearXNG instances (shared egress IP, no independent failure domain)
Rejected: Wikidata as a SearchProvider (category error — structured facts, not ranked links)
Rejected: rename SearchProvider to AuthorityResolver/ContactResolver (would re-merge Discovery/Verification boundary)
Rejected: separate event store (Inngest already a durable event log; run_steps covers query side)
Rejected: browser pool -> context pool -> page pool (context reuse bleeds cookies/storage, leaks memory)
Rejected: JSON Schema as source of truth, generate Zod (Zod already is source of truth, can emit JSON Schema)
Rejected: Playwright on Vercel (Chromium ~280MB exceeds bundle cap, chromium-min 4-8x slower)
Deferred: paid search API (Brave/Serper) — not needed at current volume
Deferred: Firecrawl — behind a feature flag if browser worker insufficient
Rejected: LangGraph (Inngest provides durability, retries, concurrency, idempotency)
